Package neqsim.process.util.monitor

Class TwoFluidPipeResponse

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.monitor.BaseResponse
neqsim.process.util.monitor.TwoFluidPipeResponse
public class TwoFluidPipeResponse extends BaseResponse
Response object for a solved TwoFluidPipe multiphase-flow calculation.

Scalar fields provide a concise engineering summary. The profile field contains the section-by-section multiphase results and is included at ReportConfig.DetailLevel.FULL detail only. Units are encoded in field names to keep the JSON contract unambiguous.
